boards.name: Voyager Infinity
boards.notes: Brand of Ikiru People Ltd, a subsidiary of Dillistone Group Plc. Multi-job posting to job boards via Broadbean and LogicMelon integrations. Contact page returned HTTP 502 and was not readable.

sources.title: About us
sources.quote: Voyager Software is a brand of Ikiru People Ltd, a subsidiary of Dillistone Group Plc.

sources.title: Partners
sources.quote: Jobs from the Infinity database are automatically sent to Broadbean for dispatch to the largest network of job boards in the world.

sources.title: Partners
sources.quote: Voyager Infinity integrates with Odro’s video recruitment software, perfect for agencies who are looking to streamline and improve the hiring process.

boards.name: Encore (Cluen)
boards.notes: Encore executive search software by Cluen. Home and about pages state no headquarters, pricing, API, partner program or parent company.

boards.name: Cornerstone OnDemand
boards.notes: Contact page lists Santa Monica, CA 90404 as worldwide corporate headquarters. Language menu codes br, de, es, fr, it, jp, kr and mx are mapped to pt, de, es, fr, it, ja, ko and es. Extend page mentions APIs but states no access route.

sources.title: Contact us
sources.quote: Worldwide corporate headquarters 1601 Cloverfield Blvd, Suite 600 South, Santa Monica, CA 90404

sources.title: Homepage language menu
sources.quote: br de es fr it jp kr mx

sources.title: Partner ecosystem
sources.quote: Cornerstone Services Partners is a curated community of global systems integrators and regional experts that help you deploy and optimize your capabilities.

boards.name: Oleeo
boards.notes: Contact page shows separate UK Headquarters and US Headquarters labels, so no single headquarters country is recorded. Partner Ecosystem page invites platforms to partner.

sources.title: Partner ecosystem
sources.quote: Oleeo partners with incredible platforms across the globe to help you recruit faster and smarter!

boards.name: Jobsoid
boards.notes: Subscription plans with a free plan, listed at $59, $119 and $299 per month when paid monthly. Homepage says one-click posting to job boards.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: Choose the plan that suites your hiring requirements the best. You can upgrade, downgrade or cancel your subscription anytime.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Publish jobs on leading job boards and social networks in just one click.

boards.name: Flatchr
boards.notes: French ATS. Docs say the API key is generated in account settings under Advanced, API. Homepage says jobs are multiposted to more than 160 job boards. Pricing page text shows no visible prices.

sources.title: Getting started
sources.quote: Votre API_KEY doit être générée dans votre espace Flatchr Paramètres avancés > Avancé > API.

sources.title: Homepage
sources.quote: Multidiffusez sur +160 jobboards, sourcez vos candidats sur Linkedin et CVthèques, et utilisez le réseau de vos collaborateurs grâce à la cooptation.

boards.name: Hireserve
boards.notes: UK-based ATS for in-house recruitment. Address on the contact page has no headquarters label. Job board integration page describes one-click posting to job boards.

sources.title: Integrations and partnerships
sources.quote: We have developed a strong ecosystem of partners and integrations to ensure you can attract, engage and assess talent as efficiently and effectively as possible.

sources.title: Job board integration
sources.quote: Post job adverts to multiple job boards with a single click using Hireserve’s integrated ATS job board functionality.

boards.name: Kenjo
boards.notes: Workforce management software with per-employee monthly pricing (6.0 and 10.0 euros shown). Recruiting module includes a native integration to post jobs to 100+ job boards. Open API is offered to software partners.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: All prices are per employee per month.

sources.title: Partner program
sources.quote: Connect your software to Kenjo via our Open API.

sources.title: Partner program
sources.quote: Connect your software to Kenjo via our Open API.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: All features of Kenjo's recruiting module + a native integration that can help you post jobs and hire from 100+ job boards.
